restaurant_name: Boonbua Clinic Spinal and deep tissue Massage
text:
Very impressive and warm experience!

I came here mainly to get help for my knee pain, but ended up receiving far more care and clarity than I expected. After three sessions, I finally understand what has been happening in my body for years.

Dr. Pat didn’t just look at my knee — he looked at my whole system. He helped me see how my knee issues, my shoulder and neck tension, and even my TMJ are all connected. For the first time, everything made sense.

Each session combined different approaches — physiotherapy, osteopathy-style adjustments, chiropractic-style releases, manual work, cupping, and targeted muscle therapy. In most places, I would have needed three or four different clinics to get this kind of integrated treatment. Here, I got all of it in one place, from a team that genuinely pays attention.

My knee feels lighter, my shoulder and neck finally know what “normal” can feel like again, and even my TMJ feels relieved in a way I haven’t felt for years. More importantly, I now have a clear plan: what to train, how to sit, how to take care of my joints, and how to prevent the same problems from returning.

I’ve seen doctors in Singapore and elsewhere before, but none of them connected the dots the way Dr. Pat did. I’m truly grateful for the care, the patience, and the kindness from him and his team.

When I return to Chiang Mai, I will definitely come back here.
Thank you, Dr. Pat and the whole team, for taking such good care of me.

text:

The pain was intense, and I struggled to move or pick things up. After just one session with Mr. Patt, I regained 80% of my mobility. Following three more sessions, I felt incredible.

Prices are reasonable at 1200 THB for the first visit and 1000 THB for subsequent sessions. They also offer certified sports massages for the same price, unlike many uncertified places in Thailand. The clinic is immaculate, and the service is exceptional from the moment you walk in. I highly recommend this place and will visit every time I'm in Chiang Mai!
